ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Four points were marked on a grid of $1 \mathrm{~cm}$ side squares. Of the possible triangular regions that can be obtained with vertices in three of these points, one has the largest area. What is this area, in $\mathrm{cm}^{2}$?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Four points were marked on a grid of $1 \mathrm{~cm}$ side squares. Of the possible triangular regions that can be obtained with vertices in three of these points, one has the largest area. What is this area, in $\mathrm{cm}^{2}$?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a grid composed of small squares with side length 1 cm. Taking the lower left corner as the coordinate origin, the positive direction of the x-axis to the right, and the positive direction of the y-axis upward, it can be read from the figure that the four marked points are respectively on grid points: A=(2,4), B=(5,2), C=(1,1), D=(2,1). Then reason: choosing any three of the four points can form 4 triangles: ABC, ABD, ACD, BCD. Use the coordinate area formula: triangle area = 1/2 |x1(y2-y3)+x2(y3-y1)+x3(y1-y2)|. The area of ABC = 1/2 |2(2-1)+5(1-4)+1(4-2)| = 1/2 |2-15+2| = 11/2 = 5.5. The area of ABD = 1/2 |2(2-1)+5(1-4)+2(4-2)| = 1/2 |2-15+4| = 9/2 = 4.5. The area of ACD = 1/2 |2(1-1)+1(1-4)+2(4-1)| = 1/2 |0-3+6| = 3/2 = 1.5. The area of BCD = 1/2 |5(1-1)+1(1-2)+2(2-1)| = 1/2 |0-1+2| = 1/2 = 0.5. Comparing shows that the maximum area is 5.5 cm^2.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram first: the four dots form a convex quadrilateral in boundary order C=(1,1), D=(2,1), B=(5,2), A=(2,4). The desired largest triangle should be one of the triangles obtained by omitting one vertex of this quadrilateral. Compute the area of the whole quadrilateral by splitting it into triangles, for example triangle C-D-A with horizontal base CD=1 and height 3, area 1.5, and triangle D-B-A with vertical base D-A=3 and horizontal distance from B to that line 3, area 4.5, so the quadrilateral area is 6. The triangle A-B-C is the quadrilateral with the small triangle C-D-B removed. That small triangle has base CD=1 and height 1, so area 0.5. Thus area(A-B-C)=6-0.5=5.5, and because the removed piece is the smallest corner triangle, this is the largest possible triangle.

推理：要求从四点中任选三点组成的三角形的最大面积。先求四边形 C-D-B-A 的面积。把它分成三角形 C-D-A 和三角形 D-B-A。三角形 C-D-A 中，CD=1，高为 3，所以面积为 1/2×1×3=1.5。三角形 D-B-A 中，DA=3，点 B 到直线 DA 的水平距离为 3，所以面积为 1/2×3×3=4.5。因此四边形面积为 1.5+4.5=6。最大的三角形是 A-B-C，它等于整个四边形减去小三角形 C-D-B。三角形 C-D-B 中，CD=1，高为 1，所以面积为 1/2×1×1=0.5。因此 area(A-B-C)=6-0.5=5.5 cm²。
